timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical publication time after the Campaign269 final validated state; not a market-data timestamp.
purpose: Perform one finite, zero-row, zero-network source-contract feasibility review for Campaign269 concept c269_01. This is not a factor definition, source acceptance, value audit, return trial or prospective activation.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: point_in_time_facility_master
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: An accepted local source must expose stable issuer, legal-entity, subsidiary and facility identifiers; coordinates with CRS and precision; operation/ownership start and end intervals; closure/addition/deletion history; and version/revision provenance for 2019-2023 without current-facility backfill.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: point_in_time_entity_facility_mapping
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: The source must bind listed instrument to legal entity, subsidiary and facility through time, including corporate actions, ownership changes, name changes and delistings, with deterministic one-to-many semantics and publication timestamps.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: versioned_hazard_observation_archive
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: One accepted local extreme-precipitation or inundation archive must provide immutable observation identity, spatial support, observation/event time, publication time, revision chain, units and 2019-2023 historical coverage. No choice among hazard subtypes, thresholds or durations may be made after values.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: public_clock_and_revision_semantics
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: Every facility and hazard fact must have a public availability clock and revision policy that proves what was knowable by the signal close; later corrections may not be backfilled into earlier signals.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: deterministic_spatial_identity_and_join
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: Coordinate reference systems, geometry identity, geocoding provenance, point/grid/polygon join behavior, boundary ties, offshore/missing coordinates and spatial-version changes must be fixed before any row.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: complete_zero_exposure_denominator_and_later_protocol
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: The source contract must enumerate the complete eligible issuer denominator including true zero exposure, distinguish zero from missing, prove 2019-2023 coverage and support, and permit one exact formula, direction, support rule, t+1/t+3 clock, no-return gates and three frozen development folds to be bound before rows.

decision_rule.admit_source_contract_only_if: All six gates are satisfied by one already accepted local point-in-time source contract whose metadata can be bound without opening a source row or value.
